brand.name: Fasal Nigrani
brand.sub: Your crop's daily guardian — understand the weather and get plain-language crop advice, anytime, in your pocket.

home.heroTitle: What does your farm need today?
home.heroSub: Weather understanding, crop photo check and quick answers — in simple language, in Hindi or English. This is not a doctor's prescription; it is a helpful first opinion.

weatherCard.title: Weather & Crop Advice
weatherCard.desc: See what today's and the coming days' weather means for your field — spray, irrigate or wait?

photoCard.title: Check a Crop Photo
photoCard.desc: Send a photo of a leaf or plant — get a fast first opinion on disease, pest damage, water stress or a deficiency.

chatCard.title: Ask a Question
chatCard.desc: Type or speak any farm question in simple words — get a short, clear answer with what to do next.

home.note: This tool gives guidance, not a guaranteed cure. If a disease or damage looks serious or is spreading, please contact your local Krishi Vigyan Kendra or an agriculture expert.

weather.title: Weather & Crop Advice
weather.subtitle: Tell us your area and we will tell you what the weather means for your field today.
weather.geoDenied: Location not available. Choose your district from the list below — your farm advice will still work.
weather.confirmSubtitle: We will give weather advice for this place.
weather.checking: Checking the weather for your field…
weather.normalSummary: Weather looks fine — no big warning for today. You can do your routine farm work.

warn.rainHigh: There is a {p}% chance of rain in the next 24 hours — this can spoil fresh irrigation or a spray.
warn.waterlog: Heavy rain ({rain} mm) may fall — waterlogging or crop lodging (falling over) is possible in standing crops.
warn.heat: Heat may reach {temp}°C — avoid fieldwork in the afternoon and water early morning or evening only.
warn.wind: Wind may blow at {wind} km/h — do not spray (the chemical will drift away), and tall or flowering crops could get physical damage.
warn.fungal: High humidity ({humidity}%) with 20–30°C temperature — fungal disease risk can rise in the next two days. Keep an eye on leaves, this is not a diagnosis.
warn.dry: No rain expected for about {days} days and heat up to {temp}°C — crops can face water stress. Use water carefully.
warn.swing: Weather is changing (about {delta}°C difference from yesterday) — keep a close watch on the crop.

act.rainNoSpray: Do not irrigate or spray today — rain may come and wash it away.
act.drainCheck: Keep drainage channels clear so water does not stand in the field.
act.heatTiming: Give water early morning or evening, not in the afternoon heat.
act.windNoSpray: Do not spray in strong wind — the chemical can drift and be wasted.
act.fungalWatch: Check under the leaves daily; if white or brown spots spread, ask an expert.
act.waterSave: Save water — no rain is expected in the coming days.
act.swingWatch: Walk the field daily while the weather keeps changing.
act.normalDay: No special action needed — continue routine care of the crop.

photo.title: Check a Crop Photo
photo.subtitle: Take a clear photo of the affected leaf or plant in daylight. We give a first opinion — not a final diagnosis.
photo.analyzingDetail: This can take 20–30 seconds. Please wait.
photo.chooseFirst: First choose or take a photo.
photo.imageTooBig: The photo could not be prepared for sending. Please choose another one.
photo.sendError: Could not send the photo. The internet may be slow — please try again.

quality.tooDark: The photo is too dark. Please retake it in good light.
quality.tooBlurry: The photo is blurry. Hold the camera steady and retake it.
quality.tooSmall: The plant is too far / too small in the photo. Go closer and retake.
quality.generic: The photo is not clear enough. Please retake it in good light.

photo.seekExpert: This may be serious or unclear. Please contact your Krishi Vigyan Kendra or an agriculture expert before spending on any treatment.
photo.emptyDesc: Take or upload a photo of your crop here. We will tell you right away what problem it could be.

chat.title: Ask a Question
chat.subtitle: Ask in your own words — about weather, a crop problem, or a photo you just checked. We answer simply and honestly.
chat.voiceUnsupported: Voice typing is not supported in this browser — please type your question.
chat.error: Could not get an answer just now. Please try again.
chat.disclaimer: Guidance only — never use a chemical dose mentioned here without an expert's advice.

common.staleNote: This is older data — the network did not respond. Refresh when connected.
common.expertLine: For serious problems always consult a Krishi Vigyan Kendra or agriculture expert near you.

errors.network: The internet is slow or not working. Please try again.
errors.server: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a moment.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests right now. Please wait a little and try again.
